clauses.clause: Whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1 life.
clauses.evidence: [you gain 3 life]: trigger [0], opp loses 1 life (20 -> 19); [you lose 2 life] -> none. The opponent gaining life is not a probe stimulus: pack marauding_blight_priest_1 (the opponent gains twice: no loss; seat 0 gains once: the opponent loses exactly 1; 27 / 33).
